display_name: FirstCore — Waive assessed overdraft fee (Fee Management)
description: Signs on to the FirstCore portal, acknowledges the authorized-user notice, opens Account Servicing » Fee Management, runs an account inquiry for the supplied account_id, and waives the assessed OVERDRAFT ITEM FEE, returning the host reversal confirmation number. Classifies no-record, closed-account, host-congestion and manager-override outcomes.

when.value: No records found for the supplied account identifier.

business_outcomes.note: Inquiry returned no account/fee records; terminal business answer.

when.value: HOST-0521: Legacy host link congested. Resubmit inquiry.

recoverable.note: Transient legacy host congestion — re-click Execute Inquiry.

when.value: Error: Account is closed. Fee waiver not permitted.

business_outcomes.note: Host rejected the reversal because the account is CLOSED; no waiver posted.

when.value: SECURITY INTERCEPTION: Manager Override PIN Required

escalate.reason: Host demands a Manager Override PIN before posting the reversal; modal is injected into the TOP document (fields #ext-gen99_pin, Authorize #ext-gen101). A human with override authority must supply the PIN.

robustness_notes: Flow: top-frame login (name-based locators j_username/j_password are stable; the Sign On / I Acknowledge controls only have generated ids ext-gen21/ext-gen33 and should fall back to visible text "Sign On" / "I Acknowledge"). Nav tree lives in navFrm: the "Account Servicing" group must be EXPANDED first — clicking the group label div did nothing; clicking the "+"/"-" toggle span (#ext-gen89) toggles it, after which the child "·Fee Management" item becomes clickable. All ext-genNN ids are generated and may churn across releases/tenants; prefer visible text fallbacks ("- Account Servicing", "·Fee Management", "Execute Inquiry", "Waive Fee"). The module UI is in the nested frame wrkFrm>modFrm; the account field is best located by name attribute input[name='acctNbr']. Busy indicator is #loading-spinner inside modFrm and shows two different captions ("Legacy host communication in progress..." for inquiry, "Posting reversal to host..." for the waiver) — always wait for it to be absent before evaluating outcomes. IMPORTANT: the manager-override security modal escapes the nested frames and is injected into the TOP document, so it must be detected with frame_path []. Result/status text is matched on stable host wording (HOST-0521 code, "No records found...", "Error: Account is closed...", "Confirmation RVSL-") rather than on generated element ids.
